title: For a repeated value, extend only the subsets the previous step created
caption: nums sorted = [1, 3, 3]. The window marks the subsets being extended, or the ones just created.

frames.text: The first 3 is new, so it extends all 2 subsets. The subsets this step creates start at index 2.
The second 3 equals the previous value. Extend only from start: [3] and [1, 3], the last step's subsets.
That adds [3, 3] and [1, 3, 3] and no duplicates. Six subsets instead of eight.
